items.title: Iran plans Hormuz 'exclusion/prohibited zone' after US–IRGC tanker and warship clashes
items.title_zh: 美伊油轮军舰交火后：伊朗拟在霍尔木兹外宣布“禁区/隔离区”
items.summary_zh: 最高国家安全委员会新任负责人Mohsen Rezaei称，将在未来数日宣布霍尔木兹海峡外“隔离区/禁区”，自美海军封锁线延伸至海湾一侧；进入并意图过峡的船只将被列入伊朗制裁名单。谈判代表Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf威胁对美进一步打击给予“更快、更猛、更痛”的回应，宣称“对等报复时代结束”。此为昨日油轮打击之后的升级话术，而非重复CENTCOM击沉三船头条本身。

quotes.author: Mohsen Rezaei / SNSC
quotes.en: Any ship that enters this area with the intention of passing through the Strait of Hormuz and is identified will be placed on our sanctions list.
quotes.zh: 任何进入该区域、意图通过霍尔木兹海峡并被识别的船只，将被列入我们的制裁名单。

items.fetch_notes: NM相关条目估分约5.6；刻意避开昨日“美打三艘伊朗油轮”同题复用；据Hindu/Straits Times/ABC

items.title: GrapheneOS Overhauled Default Apps and Secure Clipboard
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS大改默认应用与安全剪贴板
items.summary_zh: GrapheneOS翻新默认应用并强化安全剪贴板（约157赞）。评论担忧谷歌正在缓慢窒息AOSP，却仍看好Graphene押注安卓；也有人点名希望默认键盘换成FUTO。硬化ROM在“平台尚存氧气”的窗口里抢修体验。

quotes.author: pizzaiolo
quotes.en: Graphene is clearly bullish on Android, but I have no idea why. The writing is on the wall, Google is slowly asphyxiating AOSP.
quotes.zh: Graphene明显看多安卓，但我不知道为什么。墙上字很清楚：谷歌正在慢慢闷死AOSP。

quotes.author: ravenstine
quotes.en: I hope they replace the AOSP keyboard with FUTO keyboard. I'm mostly fine with the other stock apps, but that keyboard was the one thing I absolutely had to end up replacing due to its jenky behavior.
quotes.zh: 希望他们用FUTO键盘替换AOSP键盘。其他预装我大多能忍，唯独键盘是我绝对得换掉的。

items.title: OpenAI says it built an automated research intern; smarter AI researcher eyed by 2028
items.title_zh: OpenAI称已做出自动化研究实习生；更聪明的AI研究员瞄向2028
items.summary_zh: OpenAI公开“研究加速”路线：内部已部署可辅助实验与文献工作的自动化研究实习生级系统，并展望约2028年更强的自动化AI研究员，理由包括用自动化研究反哺对齐与防御。HN同步热议其博客与现实中无人值守实验流水线。能力叙事与安全叙事再次绑在同一时间表上。

quotes.author: OpenAI research acceleration note
quotes.en: We are pursuing this work in part because automated research could help us solve alignment and build defenses against increasingly capable AI.
quotes.zh: 我们推进这项工作，部分是因为自动化研究可以帮助我们解决对齐问题，并构建针对日益强大AI的防御。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.3；与HN OpenAI研究加速条目交叉印证

items.title: I Changed My License
items.title_zh: 我换了许可证：LGPL痛点与“逃逸舱口”争议
items.summary_zh: 作者叙述从LGPL迁到另一许可证的理由（约146赞）。法律向评论指出：若EUPL等含可转换到其他许可证的“逃逸”条款，强度只等于其点名的最弱许可证；也有人嫌文章不直说LGPL问题与新证如何对症。开源许可选择再次变成可审计的威胁模型。

quotes.author: apt-get
quotes.en: Worth noting that the "escape hatch" clauses in the EUPL that allow converting it into other licenses mean it's only ever as strong as the weakest license it names for such an operation, AKA EPL/MPL/LGPL. Any actor that wants to mess around with providing a closed extension on a network service can exercise that option with an EUPL codebase, so if you care about that, you're better off explicitly naming the AGPL or whatnot. EUPL is built for government agencies first, and most of the focus is ensuring that nobody has to worry about mix-and-matching it with other copyleft licenses, plus legal language that covers and harmonizes variations in notions of copyright/patents/intellectual property across EU countries, not so much waging war against hyperscalers. (But it's still great to have around!)
quotes.zh: 值得注意：EUPL里允许转换到其他许可证的“逃逸舱口”条款，意味着它的强度永远只等于它为此点名的最弱许可证。

quotes.author: dotancohen
quotes.en: This article would do better if it simply enumerated the problems with the LGPL and addressed how this new license which I've never heard of addresses those problems. This hinting and alluding might make great SEO, but that's fit for neither the audience of people producing software, nor for HN.
quotes.zh: 这篇文章如果直接列举LGPL的问题，并说明这个我没听说过的新许可证如何对症，会好得多。

items.title: Houthi offensive near Bab el-Mandeb brings heaviest Yemen fighting in years
items.title_zh: 胡塞在曼德海峡附近发动攻势：也门数年最重战斗
items.summary_zh: 胡塞自周四起进攻，试图切断政府控制的Mokha港并逼近红海入口曼德海峡周边；AFP统计开战以来战斗人员与部分平民死亡逾300，单日时段政府军称84人阵亡。2022停火于今年7月崩溃后，这是阿拉伯半岛国家数年最激烈交火之一，与霍尔木兹紧张叠加，威胁红海—苏伊士航运。

quotes.author: AFP tally / ABC News
quotes.en: More than 300 combatants and some civilians have been killed since the start of the Houthi assault on Thursday.
quotes.zh: 自周四胡塞攻势开始以来，已有超过300名战斗人员以及部分平民死亡。

items.title: It took a year to ship WebAssembly in Anubis
items.summary_zh: 反爬挑战项目Anubis引入Wasm的工程复盘约119赞。作者吐槽特定部署环境的人“友善方差很大”；评论质疑中期假设：若刮取方（AI公司）掌握算力与动机，证明题能否持续有效。安全经济学与社区脾气并列。

quotes.author: vintagedave
quotes.en: > In my experience the kinds of people who run this exact combination of circumstances also tend to be the kind of people that have a wide variance in the level of kindness they display to the authors of open source programs that happen to be in their way. Love this. There’s been past discussion on HN re how OSS maintainers are treated, and this is such a wry sentence. I really appreciate the tone / attitude to the problem.
quotes.zh: 以我的经验，会把这一精确组合环境跑起来的人，友善程度的方差往往也特别大。

quotes.author: raincole
quotes.en: It's still very unclear to me how Anubis is supposed to work in the long term or even the medium term. The assumption is that scrappers, a.k.a. AI companies, a.k.a. those who hog all the RAM, are short of memory...?
quotes.zh: 我仍很不清楚Anubis中期乃至长期到底怎么成立。假设是刮取方——也就是AI公司——会一直吃下这些成本？

items.title: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches to map dark energy and exoplanets
items.title_zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜发射：测绘暗能量与系外行星
items.summary_zh: NASA罗曼太空望远镜按任务规划升空，广视场红外巡天旨在约束暗能量、绘制宇宙结构并开展系外行星微引力透镜普查，被视为韦伯之后下一代旗舰级巡天平台。对宇宙学参数与宜居带行星统计将提供新基线。

quotes.author: NASA Roman mission description
quotes.en: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will map the universe’s mysteries with a wide-field infrared survey of dark energy and exoplanets.
quotes.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜将以广视场红外巡天，测绘暗能量与系外行星等宇宙之谜。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.2；公开任务报道综合

items.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
items.title_zh: 研究加速：OpenAI内部视角下的自动化研究员
items.summary_zh: OpenAI分享内部研究加速与自动化实验流水线（约101赞），称自动化研究有助于对齐与防御。评论抓住“自动化研究员”表述；也有人对照自己用更强模型+工具在3月起实现24/7无人值守任务。实验室叙事与独立开发者日历互相印证。

quotes.author: carbonguy
quotes.en: > ... We are pursuing this work in part because automated research could help us solve alignment and build defenses against increasingly capable AI. An automated AI researcher can also be an automated safety or alignment researcher. More capable, aligned systems could help secure critical infrastructure, defend against dangerous AI agents, and develop new protective measures. In other words... "We must pursue advancements in AI to protect us against advancements in AI?" edit: there's so much to be critical of in this blog post, just going to throw two more points in here that really stood out to me: 1) all of the metrics are effectively pointing out "we're using way more AI!" - but nothing about impact. What has all this token burn done for them, actually? Let them claim they have more self-licking ice-cream cones than before? 2) in section 3 they break down what the token burn is going towards. Most of the spend is: a) building, b) documenting, and c) monitoring research infra i.e. they're using AI systems which they already recognize may be misaligned to build the systems that they believe will help them identify future misalignment? to which I guess the rebuttal is "no no, we're
quotes.zh: ……我们推进这项工作，部分是因为自动化研究可以帮助解决对齐，并构建针对日益强大AI的防御。自动化AI研究员可以……

quotes.author: hedgehog
quotes.en: This roughly lines up with my personal experience that in March a combination of stronger models and better tooling on my end let me start running jobs unattended 24/7 (using Anthropic sub and my own hardware). Their $8000/day per researcher spend is crazy though, I'm curious how they keep track of the work.
quotes.zh: 这大致符合我的个人体验：今年3月，更强模型加上更好工具，让我开始能用Anthropic等跑24/7无人值守任务。

items.title: NATO Northern Viking held without US warships or combat aircraft for first time in decades
items.title_zh: 北约Northern Viking数十年来首次无美军舰与作战飞机参与
items.summary_zh: Politico等报道：冰岛附近年度反潜演习Northern Viking由法国海军军官指挥，加拿大军舰、德国侦察机、比利时战机追踪科拉半岛方向俄潜艇航线；数十年来首次无美国军舰或作战飞机直接参演。美方仍在凯夫拉维克机场建设并参与计划。欧洲官员借此证明北美以外盟友可自主守护北大西洋，也折射美舰队重心他移。

quotes.author: Politico / allied officials framing
quotes.en: Allied officials designed the exercise to demonstrate that European nations and Canada possess the capability to secure the North Atlantic without reliant US leadership.
quotes.zh: 盟军官员设计此次演习，是为证明欧洲国家与加拿大有能力在不过度依赖美国领导的情况下守卫北大西洋。

items.title: Babylonian Lamb Stew with Beets (1750–1730 BCE)
items.title_zh: 巴比伦炖羊肉配甜菜（约前1750年）：泥板食谱上桌
items.summary_zh: 复原约公元前1750–1730年巴比伦炖羊肉配甜菜的帖约86赞。有人安利即将付印的古代食谱书；有人惊叹以现代标准盐少得惊人。三千年前的锅气，成为首页上的慢变量。

quotes.author: harel
quotes.en: Coincidentally this book which has been a labour of love of his creator is going into print this week: https://www.tableofgods.com It's quite expensive though, but it does look amazing.
quotes.zh: 巧的是，作者心血之作本周要付印了：tableofgods.com。挺贵，但看起来很棒。

quotes.author: PeterHolzwarth
quotes.en: What's enlightening is how astonishingly little salt is used, by our standards.
quotes.zh: 启发在于：以我们的标准，盐用得少得惊人。
